articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Meloni stated she has no regrets about her political investment in relations with Trump and reaffirmed Italy's commitment to increasing defense spending in a sustainable manner while maintaining national priorities.

articles.title: Meloni, l'Europa difenda i propri confini con umanità ma anche intransigenza
articles.summary: Meloni expressed support for a new European sanctions regime targeting criminal networks involved in migrant trafficking, stating that Europe must govern migration flows rather than being subjected to them.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù'
articles.summary: Meloni stated that if her political coalition wins the next elections, a right-wing president of the Republic could become possible, asserting that those outside the center-left have equal rights to the highest positions.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Meloni confirmed her availability to testify as a civil party witness in the Milan trial against Fabrizio Corona and another defendant, charged with aggravated defamation for false claims published in 2023.
